name: LaMoine Frank "Bugs" Oden
sources: Obituary of Mary (Kelley) Falde Oden, Sioux City Journal, Dec 2018, and Find a Grave, memorial 195276916 (Grace Hill Cemetery, Hawarden, map 3 block 905 lot 4)
notes: Second husband of Mary Falde, whom she married after Roger Falde’s death in 1992.
LaMoine Frank Oden, 1925–2016; married Mary (Kelley) Falde at Sedona on 29 May 1999 (Find a Grave, memorial 190745116).
